# Vendored libraries

Served from GitHub Pages so the bookmarklet doesn't depend on third-party CDNs.
Files are copied unmodified from the npm packages listed below.

| Library | Version | Files | Licence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [@mozilla/readability](https://github.com/mozilla/readability) | 0.6.0 | `readability/Readability.js` | Apache-2.0 (`readability/LICENSE.md`) | `npm pack @mozilla/readability@0.6.0` |
| [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip) | 3.10.2 | `jszip/jszip.min.js` (from `dist/`) | MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later (`jszip/LICENSE.markdown`) | `npm pack jszip@3.10.2` |

To update: `npm pack <name>@<version>`, extract, copy the same files over, and update this table.
